section_summary: This section records arrangements for Japanese training vessels visiting United States ports in 1936, especially the Yakumo and Iwate squadron and training ships visiting Hawaii. It includes itineraries, requests for official courtesies, immigration and customs replies, and corrections to the squadron’s schedule and an officer’s name. The final pages concern a dispute over Japanese participation in Seattle’s Fourth of July parade.

people.name: Zengo Yoshida
people.role: Vice admiral and commander of the Japanese Training Squadron

people.name: Kakuji Kakuta

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note on officers’ visits to Canada and Mexico
subfiles.about: Gives travel plans for squadron officers visiting Vancouver, Ensenada and Ottawa without passports.
subfiles.summary: Lists the officers, destinations, dates and routes, and asks that United States authorities be informed.

subfiles.title: State Department note to Treasury on training squadron officers
subfiles.about: Requests customs courtesies and free entry for squadron officers returning from Canada and Mexico.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Japanese notes and explains the waiver of passport and visa requirements for reentry to the vessels.

subfiles.title: State Department reply approving officers’ visits
subfiles.about: Approves the officers’ proposed visits and waives passport and visa requirements for their reentry.
subfiles.summary: The first page is unreadable; the surviving page confirms interdepartmental arrangements and the waiver.

subfiles.title: Passport Division routing note
subfiles.about: Forwards papers received from the Japanese Consulate General in New York.
subfiles.summary: Requests appropriate action on the consular papers.

subfiles.title: Japanese consul’s letter to Ira A. Hoyt
subfiles.about: Announces the Yakumo and Iwate squadron’s expected New York arrival and requests courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the itinerary, ship particulars and names of senior officers.

subfiles.title: 1936 itinerary of the Yakumo and Iwate
subfiles.from: Japanese Consulate General in New York
subfiles.about: Lists the training ships’ foreign port calls and dates.
subfiles.summary: Provides the cruise schedule; several entries are obscured by OCR.

subfiles.title: Training squadron officers and personnel
subfiles.from: Japanese Consulate General in New York
subfiles.about: Identifies senior officers and gives crew and trainee totals.
subfiles.summary: Names the commander, ship captains and staff chiefs, with personnel counts.

subfiles.title: Particulars and histories of the Yakumo and Iwate
subfiles.from: Japanese Consulate General in New York
subfiles.about: Describes the ships’ size, speed and naval service histories.
subfiles.summary: Gives specifications and chronological accounts of both vessels, including Russo-Japanese War service and later training cruises.

subfiles.title: Reply to Ira A. Hoyt
subfiles.about: Confirms receipt of the Japanese consul’s papers.
subfiles.summary: Says the schedule had already reached the department through diplomatic channels and had been distributed.

subfiles.title: Immigration Service reply on the training squadron
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions to extend lawful courtesies to Yakumo and Iwate personnel.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the May 1 notification and promises customary immigration courtesies.

subfiles.title: Copy of Immigration Service reply on the training squadron
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Immigration Service reply on squadron personnel.
subfiles.summary: Records the same promise of immigration courtesies.

subfiles.title: Immigration Service reply on the Onda visit
subfiles.about: Acknowledges notice of a Japanese transport’s calls at Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Says district directors at both ports were instructed.

subfiles.title: Copy of Immigration Service reply on the transport
subfiles.about: Duplicates the reply concerning the Japanese transport’s port calls.
subfiles.summary: Confirms instructions to Los Angeles and Honolulu officials.

subfiles.title: Immigration Service reply on passport waiver
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions concerning passport and visa waivers for squadron officers.
subfiles.summary: Says officers’ names need not be submitted.

subfiles.title: Copy of Immigration Service passport-waiver reply
subfiles.about: Duplicates the reply on squadron officers’ passport and visa waivers.
subfiles.summary: Confirms instructions and says individual names are unnecessary.

subfiles.title: Treasury authorization for squadron port visits
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs collectors to extend usual courtesies at scheduled ports.
subfiles.summary: Names collectors serving the Yakumo and Iwate itinerary.

subfiles.title: State Department procedural note
subfiles.about: Comments that the existing procedure appears to work satisfactorily.
subfiles.summary: Recommends leaving the procedure as it stands.

subfiles.title: Navy Department objection to late schedule notifications
subfiles.about: Criticizes late official notice of the Japanese tanker Onda’s delayed arrivals.
subfiles.summary: Reports inadequate notice to naval districts for Hilo and Los Angeles and urges prompt diplomatic notification of changes.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms an order to extend courtesies to Nihon Maru in Hawaii.
subfiles.summary: A cable instructed the Hawaiian Department to assist the vessel.

subfiles.title: Agriculture Department reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms animal-industry officials were advised of Nihon Maru’s Hawaiian visit.
subfiles.summary: The Honolulu inspector was instructed to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Hawaii governor’s acknowledgement of squadron visit
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the planned October visit of the Japanese Training Squadron to Hawaii.
subfiles.summary: Promises customary courtesies; the Interior Department forwarded the letter to State.

subfiles.title: Immigration Service reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms immigration arrangements for Nihon Maru’s calls in Hawaii.
subfiles.summary: Lists Kahului, Kealakekua and Kailua and requests lawful courtesies for the crew.

subfiles.title: Copy of Immigration Service reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Duplicates the immigration reply on Nihon Maru’s Hawaiian itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Confirms instructions to Honolulu officials.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note revising Vancouver visit
subfiles.about: Changes the officers’ Vancouver travel to a July 1 steamer departure and July 2 automobile return.
subfiles.summary: Names Yoshida, Nakamura, Kakuta and seventeen other officers.

subfiles.title: State Department notification to Treasury of Vancouver change
subfiles.about: Reports the revised Vancouver travel schedule for squadron officers.
subfiles.summary: Requests that customs arrangements reflect their July 2 return to Seattle.

subfiles.title: State Department notification to Labor of officers’ schedule
subfiles.about: Provides the revised travel schedule for officers visiting Vancouver, Ensenada and Ottawa.
subfiles.summary: Lists the officers and routes for each visit so immigration officials can arrange reentry.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgement of Vancouver change
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the changed Vancouver itinerary and reports notice to federal departments.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the July 1–2 travel plan.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on Nihon Maru customs courtesies
subfiles.about: Authorizes Honolulu customs officials to assist Nihon Maru.
subfiles.summary: Reports a telegram directing customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: White House memorandum on requested presidential meeting
subfiles.about: Advises delaying a reply to the request for President Roosevelt to receive Japanese officers.
subfiles.summary: Anticipates the President’s absence at Hyde Park in August.

subfiles.title: State Department letter to McIntyre on squadron reception
subfiles.about: Forwards the Japanese request for a presidential meeting and review of officers and midshipmen.
subfiles.summary: Explains the request, notes earlier presidential receptions of Japanese commanders, and says the Ambassador was told an appointment could not yet be fixed.

subfiles.title: State Department reply declining presidential meeting
subfiles.about: Says the President cannot receive the officers on August 19.
subfiles.summary: Explains that he will be absent from Washington.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on Coast Guard courtesies for Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms Coast Guard arrangements for Nihon Maru’s Hawaiian visit.
subfiles.summary: Says instructions for customary courtesies have been issued.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on Nihon Maru port calls
subfiles.about: Raises no objection to Nihon Maru visiting normally closed Hawaiian ports.
subfiles.summary: Advises local naval authorities to extend courtesies, while stating that the visit should create no precedent.

subfiles.title: Hawaii governor’s acknowledgement of Nihon Maru visit
subfiles.about: Acknowledges notice of Nihon Maru’s June Hawaiian itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Names Kahului, Kealakekua and Kailua; Interior forwarded the letter to State.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for Shintoku Maru’s August calls at Hilo and Nawiliwili.
subfiles.summary: Gives the vessel’s school affiliation and arrival and departure dates.

subfiles.title: State Department request to Navy on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests naval courtesies for Shintoku Maru’s Hawaiian visits.
subfiles.summary: Provides the Hilo and Nawiliwili schedule.

subfiles.title: State Department request to War on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Shintoku Maru at Hawaiian ports.
subfiles.summary: Lists the August Hilo and Nawiliwili calls.

subfiles.title: State Department request to Treasury on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customs courtesies for Shintoku Maru’s Hawaiian itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Lists the scheduled Hilo and Nawiliwili visits.

subfiles.title: State Department request to Labor on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests immigration courtesies for Shintoku Maru in Hawaii.
subfiles.summary: Provides the vessel’s August port schedule.

subfiles.title: State Department request to Interior on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Shintoku Maru’s Hawaiian visits.
subfiles.summary: Gives the Hilo and Nawiliwili dates.

subfiles.title: State Department request to Agriculture on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Shintoku Maru’s Hawaiian visits.
subfiles.summary: Gives the Hilo and Nawiliwili dates.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgement to Japanese Ambassador
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the request for Shintoku Maru and promises further advice.
subfiles.summary: Says interested federal departments are being consulted.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on officers’ customs privileges
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies for officers returning from Vancouver and Ensenada.
subfiles.summary: Requests the port of return from Ottawa before arranging similar privileges there.

subfiles.title: Immigration Service acknowledgement of revised schedule
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the officers’ revised visits to Vancouver, Ensenada and Ottawa.
subfiles.summary: Says appropriate port officials are being informed.

subfiles.title: Seattle mayor’s parade request
subfiles.about: Requests permission for Japanese squadron personnel to join Seattle’s Fourth of July parade.
subfiles.summary: Says the American Legion is organizing the celebration.

subfiles.title: State Department handwritten routing note
subfiles.about: Contains a largely illegible handwritten comment on the Seattle parade request.
subfiles.summary: The OCR does not support a fuller reading.

subfiles.title: Interim reply to Seattle mayor
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the parade request pending a decision.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further reply after consultation.

subfiles.title: State Department consultation with War Department
subfiles.about: Requests comments on Japanese participation, possibly under arms, in Seattle’s parade.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the mayor’s letter and asks whether a formal diplomatic request would be approved.

subfiles.title: State Department consultation with Navy Department
subfiles.about: Requests comments on Japanese participation in Seattle’s parade.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the mayor’s letter and asks for a prompt view on a possible diplomatic request.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on revised Vancouver return
subfiles.about: Updates Seattle customs officials on the officers’ July 2 return from Vancouver.
subfiles.summary: Confirms notice to the collector of customs.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions to extend courtesies to Shintoku Maru.
subfiles.summary: Refers the vessel’s Hawaiian itinerary to the commanding general there.

subfiles.title: Protocol Division telephone memorandum
subfiles.about: Records preliminary War and Navy views on Japanese parade participation.
subfiles.summary: War opposed marching under arms; Navy was considering the absence of a formal Japanese request.

subfiles.title: Mayor Dore’s first urgent telegram
subfiles.about: Presses for immediate permission for Japanese personnel to join Seattle’s parade.
subfiles.summary: Says the mayor needs an answer to invite the Japanese consul.

subfiles.title: State Department initial refusal to Mayor Dore
subfiles.about: Advises against Japanese participation in Seattle’s parade.
subfiles.summary: Says authorization cannot be given and urges that the proposal be dropped without publicity.

subfiles.title: Mayor Dore’s second urgent telegram
subfiles.about: Again requests immediate permission for Japanese parade participation.
subfiles.summary: Asks for a reply by Postal Telegraph.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy correction of schedule and officer’s name
subfiles.about: Changes the squadron’s Colón departure to August 6 and standardizes Captain Kakuta’s name.
subfiles.summary: Explains that Kakuta had appeared as Kakuda and Tsunoda in earlier notes.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgement of Japanese corrections
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the revised Colón departure and Captain Kakuta’s preferred name.
subfiles.summary: Says interested federal departments have been advised.

subfiles.title: Tokyo Embassy despatch on the Japanese squadron cruise
subfiles.about: Reports the squadron’s itinerary and Japanese press expectations for its American visit.
subfiles.summary: Provides a port-by-port schedule and notes press interest in the first Atlantic coast cruise since the Manchurian Incident. Grew reports Yoshida’s public remarks about explaining Japan’s position, while the embassy sees no unusual political significance.

subfiles.title: Mayor Dore’s request to reconsider parade refusal
subfiles.about: Asks State to reverse its refusal after an invitation has already been publicized.
subfiles.summary: Warns that withdrawal could insult Japanese visitors and residents.

subfiles.title: Senator Bone’s office forwards parade appeal
subfiles.about: Forwards a telegram urging permission for Japanese participation in Seattle’s celebration.
subfiles.summary: Requests notice of further State Department action.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs memorandum on parade decision
subfiles.about: Records congressional appeals and the interdepartmental reconsideration of the Seattle invitation.
subfiles.summary: Describes calls from Senators Bone’s and Schwellenbach’s offices, including news that the Japanese admiral had already accepted. A June 30 State, War and Navy conference approved a revised telegram to Mayor Dore; the senators’ offices were then informed.

subfiles.title: Transcription of American Legion telegram to Senator Bone
subfiles.from: Walter Pollitz and John J. Sullivan
subfiles.about: Urges federal approval of the already extended Japanese parade invitation.
subfiles.summary: Says withdrawal would be embarrassing and asks for Senator Schwellenbach’s help.

subfiles.title: Copy of American Legion telegram to Senator Bone
subfiles.from: Walter Pollitz and John J. Sullivan
subfiles.about: Copies the American Legion’s appeal concerning the Japanese admiral and cadets.
subfiles.summary: Describes the planned review and march at Seattle’s celebration.

subfiles.title: Revised State Department telegram to Mayor Dore
subfiles.about: Responds to the already extended invitation while setting out national protocol concerns.
subfiles.summary: Says the local organizers should stand by their invitation on their own responsibility and consult state, Army and Navy officials. It explicitly permits the Japanese admiral to join the review and encourages hospitality for the visitors.

subfiles.title: File copy of revised telegram to Mayor Dore
subfiles.about: Duplicates the revised State Department response on Seattle’s parade.
subfiles.summary: Records the same advice on local responsibility, consultation and courtesies to the Japanese visitors.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to San Diego exposition invitation
subfiles.about: Points to Grew’s report on an invitation to the Japanese squadron to visit the San Diego exposition.
subfiles.summary: Cross-references another file for the invitation.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs note on Navy’s parade position
subfiles.about: Clarifies the Navy Department’s general view of foreign participation in local parades.
subfiles.summary: Captain Canaga says Navy disfavors the practice in principle.

subfiles.title: Navy Department reply on Seattle parade
subfiles.about: Gives Navy’s view on Japanese personnel joining Seattle’s Fourth of July parade.
subfiles.summary: Raises no objection to participation but considers a precedent inadvisable without a request through Japanese diplomatic channels.
